Another look-and-feel choice, so I'll just give you my preference — both leave the bookmark in the same state, so either works.

If I'm picking: I actually like the explicit "Mark as read" better here. Unchecking the box does the job, but "Mark as read" says in plain words what I'm doing — I've read it, clear it off my list. The bare checkbox is a little ambiguous; unticking it could read like I'm just undoing a mistake rather than saying "done." So my pick is the "Mark as read" action for clearing it.

Interesting though — earlier for *flagging* an item I leaned toward the checkbox because it was easy to see on/off at a glance. So if it's easy on your end, my ideal would be: a clear checkbox to see and set the read-later state, but a plainly-labeled "Mark as read" when I'm clearing it from the focused list. If you have to pick just one style, go with whatever's simplest to build — this isn't a strong requirement. Let's keep moving.
